description: Switch a discount code on or off. A disabled code is refused as not active when a cart applies it; orders already placed keep their discount, and the code's settings stay for when it is switched back on. To change the code's value, dates or limits, update_discount. Returns the discount's id, code and enabled.

enabled.description: false switches the code off, true switches it back on

idOrSlug.description: The discount's id or code (from list_discounts)

name: set_discount_enabled
title: Set discount enabled
